CardDescription.DefaultText:
A furnace hot enough to smelt iron. Only accept charcoal as fuel.

Requires bellows or a windy location to reach high enough temperatures.

Can be lit with tinder, provided it has enough fuel.
CardDescription.Text:
温度足以熔炼铁的熔炉。仅接受木炭作为燃料。

需要风箱或在多风的区域才能达到足够高的温度。

只要有足够的燃料，就可以用火绒点燃。
